title: Regional model compatibility probebook and customer-signal synthesis
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Objective: create an operational 'probebook' for rapid, repeatable field probes that measure model compatibility and substitution risk across regions (NA/EU/APAC). The probebook will surface customer signals (telemetry, procurement cues, buyer interviews) that indicate friction or success when customers switch models or try inference fallback paths.

Background: product and GTM have an increasing number of signals about regional model substitutions (edge RAG latency, quantization differences, legal/regulatory availability). Existing trackers are broad; we need a reproducible, scoped playbook that yields actionable signals within 2 weeks of a probe run.

Scope:
- Design 3 probe templates (embeddings-heavy search, RAG with <512 context, high-throughput chat path) tuned by region.
- Instrument data collection and small surveys to capture qualitative buyer intent and engineering friction.
- Produce a synthesis playbook that maps observed signals to recommended operational actions (fallback rules, model pinning thresholds, pricing guardrails).

Deliverables:
1) Probe templates as markdown + example curl/SDK runs.
2) Data collection schema and dashboard prototype (Grafana/Looker links).
3) 1-page decision canvas that maps signals -> actions -> estimated cost impact.
4) A short runbook for Solutions Engineering to run against customer requests.

Success criteria: playbook yields at least two non-trivial operational recommendations for Dedicated/Private customers in the pilot cohort and identifies at least one latent procurement sensitivity per region.
